description.title: About Us
description.text: Based on the Indonesian Standard Classification of Business Fields (KBLI) 74901, Lex Lingua Academica operates in translation services from source language to target language, with attention to terminology equivalence, language sense, academic context, and cultural aspects. We are committed to delivering accurate, natural translations that meet international standards to support individuals, educational institutions, researchers, organizations, and professionals.
